context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 25 tested Resend email integration. Key findings: (1) email_service.py has send_invite_email, send_password_reset_email, send_welcome_email functions, (2) POST /api/admin/invite returns email_sent field (false when domain not verified - expected), (3) Full invite flow works: invite -> validate -> setup -> login, (4) POST /api/auth/forgot-password sends reset email (fails silently if domain not verified), (5) POST /api/auth/setup-account sends welcome email and returns access_token, (6) Frontend invite modal shows email status after creation, (7) Setup account page shows ACCTA branding with password form, (8) Invalid token shows 'Convite Invalido' error page.
